meta.move: Strong path to agreement with a deadline said aloud
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste the time. Why was there a zero on my son's essay before anyone called me?
I owe you an apology: I put the zero in before calling you. That was my mistake.
Okay. And who decided on the zero, Hale, and on what basis?
On November 2 I asked Owen what 'epistemological paralysis' means. He said 'like, being stuck', and he couldn't tell me which scene his second paragraph was about. I wrote that down the same day.
I'm writing down November 2 and "like, being stuck." That's your account of a conversation, Hale, and I wasn't there. Show me the note you wrote that day, with the date on it.
His October 15 outline argued Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay never mentions cowardice.

I'm writing that down: October 15, cowardice. Students change their argument between an outline and an essay, Hale, and that's called revising. You've told me two things so far and shown me nothing, so is the outline in your hand or not?
Here's my offer: a supervised rewrite, Thursday at 8:15 in my room. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I'll send you that in writing by Friday at 3 PM.

A rewrite is what your own procedure offers after a concern has been established, Hale, and you haven't shown me one. The zero comes off first. Then we talk about Thursday at 8:15, and I'll want your terms in writing before Friday at 3 PM, not by it.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero on Owen's essay be withdrawn before anything else is discussed. I expect your terms in writing before Friday at 3 PM.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn before any talk of a rewrite.
What moved her: Nothing moved her position, though owning the early zero in one sentence, without defending it, earned a small sign of ground.
What cost ground: Describing the November 2 conversation and the October 15 outline without putting either document in front of her left her with only your account, and offering the rewrite before you had justified the zero let her insist the zero come off first.
Try next time: When she asked for the note you wrote on November 2, put it or the outline in front of her before you offered the rewrite.
